text:
jana: Heads up — seeing SSE stream chunk ordering break after a client reconnect. Repro: start stream -> kill client (CTRL+C) -> reconnect -> some partial `data:` events arrive out of order and the final `event: done` never shows. Happening against hosted API in us-west-2. Logs below, trying to reproduce reliably.
ryan: Ugh, we saw something similar in the JS SDK last quarter. Parser assumes events are separated cleanly by "\n\n" but when sockets reconnect chunks can be concatenated or split mid-event.
maria: Can you paste the raw bytes / chunk boundaries you see? Also what's the client timeout and are you using keep-alives?
jana: Raw stream capture (simplified):
```
data: {"seq":1,"text":"Hello "}

data: {"seq":2,"text":"world"}

data: {"seq":3,"text":"!"}
\n<client disconnect>\n
/data: {"seq":2,"text":"world"}\ndata: {"seq":3,"text":"!"}\n\n/event: done\ndata: {"seq":4,"text":"\n"}\n
```
Note the stray leading `/` and the duplicated seq=2 when reconnect happens.
tess: Looks like the server sometimes flushes a half-event at disconnect and the client-side concat produces `/data:` prefix. We should avoid brittle string-splitting in SDK parser.
ryan: For the JS SDK patch I started, parsing now uses a small state machine: buffer until we see `\n\n`, then parse each `data:` line, and maintain a small seq map to drop duplicates. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-js/pull/457 (WIP)
ops-bot: stream-health(us-west-2): 2/5 checks failing in the last 10m, increased error rate for streaming connections. See incident page: https://internal/streams/174
maria: Two actionable things: 1) server should include explicit sequence id header or field on each SSE event (we already put seq in JSON but make it mandatory), 2) emit a periodic `:ping` event every 30s to keep proxies from closing connections.
ryan: Agree. SDK change + server guarantee for seq will make client robust. I'll add logic to reorder by seq and discard duplicates, and add timeout logic to await missing seq for 200ms before reordering.
jana: Also hitting client disconnects with mobile clients — some libs close long-poll quickly. Increasing client read timeout to 120s + ping should help.
tess: We should add an integration test that performs a mid-stream TCP close and reconnection asserting final assembled text is in-order.
ryan: Filed SDK issue #457, server ticket INF-993 for seq guarantee + pings. Drafting unit tests.
maria: Nice. Also add a small note in the SDK migration guide about changed streaming semantics (buffering behavior) and the backward-compatible flag `sse_strict_reorder=false` for a release cycle.
jana: Trying the JS SDK branch + server pings against staging now. Will report back in ~30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy of streaming-fix branch to staging started: https://deploys/internal/streaming-fix
jana: Update: staging run passed initial smoke, but seeing one case where `seq` is missing from a 0.01% of events. @maria created patch to default missing seq to incremental server counter. Plan: merge server patch + SDK PR, add integration test, and ship canary to prod tomorrow morning.
ryan: I'll add logs to SDK so we can detect and report missing seq to monitoring (sentry event)
maria: Great. Closing loop: INF-993 and SDK-457 tracked. Follow-up doc in devex/streaming-best-practices.md (WIP).
